name: Hikami Karen
source:
She is a member of the same cheerleading club as her sister. She is the vice president of the club. She is aggressive and has a strong temperament.

Contrary to her older sister, she has excellent athletic skills, but her grades at school are not good. She is the type of person who acts before thinking.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080131193824/http://www.finish-game.com/games/cheergirl/cha2_chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
